text: Be honest. Your last caffeine of the day is usually...

poll.followup: Thursday: share the result, then the tip. Caffeine has a half-life of about 5 hours, so a 5 PM chai is still half there at 10 PM. Suggest moving the last cup before 2 PM for a week and seeing what changes.
